authority: Owner requested copy and design replacement and authorized Pages deployment.
audience: People who want a capable personal AI agent without understanding skill architecture.
primary_task: Understand the offer, decide Nova fits, get the free package, and complete installation.
platform: Static responsive GitHub Pages site with keyboard, pointer, and touch navigation.
evidence_state: Owner brief plus repository/package facts; static 11-page acceptance passed locally and in the public Pages deployment. Browser visual inspection was attempted on localhost and the deployed HTTPS page but was blocked by an unavailable admin-enforced browser security check. No representative-user study or outcome analytics.
highest_supportable_claim: Deployed static site with deterministic structure, link, metadata, responsive-style, and accessibility-baseline checks. Browser visual inspection, representative usability outcomes, and formal accessibility conformance are not established.
next_gate: Optional human or policy-enabled target-browser visual review; a contrary observation reopens only the affected page or style rule.
